Usage: impeccable font-fetch "<Family>" [--weights 400,700] [--italic] [--out assets/fonts]

Download a Google font's WOFF2 files (latin and latin-ext) into the project and
print the @font-face rules for them, paths relative to the project root.

--weights <list>  Comma-separated weights (default 400,700).
--italic          Also fetch the italics.
--out <dir>       Where the files go, relative to here (default assets/fonts).
